name: Bolonious
source:
[spoiler]He is a famous doctor in Hamlet. He has retired as a knight, but he is well-known as the strongest Zero Knight. People called him names such as 'The Strongest Knight, Ultimate Knight, Ultimate Ranger, Legendary Ranger'.

He was the principle of Ranger Academy.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]An important figure in Snake Crest.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]He is the father of [url=https://vndb.org/c72227]Ophelia[/url].[/spoiler]
